lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A cluster of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel maxima is visible posterior to the gill slits. The arrangement exhibits a higher density of smaller spots immediately following the fifth gill slit, transitioning to larger, more spaced-out blobs in the mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated luminance are present, particularly in the mid-flank area, where they intersect with high-intensity circular blobs to create a semi-ordered grid-like pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible in the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp light-on-top, shadow-below vertical intensity gradient, extending from the dorsal margin of the gill area toward the posterior.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced caustic network patterns resulting from surface light refraction are overlaid on the dorsal and upper-flank regions, creating a high-intensity white mesh that interferes with the underlying biological pigmentation.
